quick_skim.title: Scaled boundary cubature scheme in higher dimensions: integration over polytopes and curved regions
quick_skim.abstract: We extend the scaled boundary cubature (SBC) scheme from planar regions to higher-dimensional regions described by oriented boundary patches. The resulting parametrization transforms integrals over compact regions in $\Re^d$ into sums of integrals over the boundary-patch parameter domains and a radial coordinate. In three dimensions, this yields a direct volume-integration rule for solids bounded by affine faces, triangular or tensor-product surface patches, B-spline patches, NURBS patches, and combinations of curved and affine boundary representations. For affine polytopes, recursive application of the scaled boundary map yields nested tensor-product rules over simplex sectors; in three dimensions, these reduce to tetrahedral-sector rules that apply equally to convex and nonconvex oriented polyhedra. We also develop transformations for weakly singular integrands. Placing the scaling center at a point singularity exposes the radial power cancelled by the Jacobian, while generalized radial scalings and Gauss--Jacobi quadrature handle fractional powers. A transverse scaled-boundary map provides the analogous construction for affine singular sets, with straight-line examples in three dimensions. Numerical examples verify polynomial exactness on affine polyhedra and a four-dimensional tesseract, rapid convergence on curved B-spline and NURBS solids, and the expected convergence improvements for point and line singularities. Near-boundary singularity tests also identify when additional patch subdivision or patch-parameter transformations are required.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Extends scaled boundary cubature to higher dimensions, enabling integration over polytopes and curved regions via boundary patches and a radial coordinate, yielding nested tensor-product rules in 3D.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 本文将比例边界求积方法从平面区域推广到高维区域，通过将区域积分转化为边界面片参数域与径向坐标的积分，实现了多面体及曲面边界三维区域的直接体积积分。对于仿射多面体，可递归得到单纯形扇区上的嵌套张量积规则，三维情况下退化为四面体规则。该方法为计算电磁学中PEEC等需要对复杂几何体进行积分建模的应用提供了有力工具。

quick_skim.matched_query_text: Papers central to BGA焊球互连建模、串扰分析及等效电路提取相关预印本论文检索, especially work that connects or combines: PEEC package modeling; equivalent circuit modeling; parasitic capacitance inductance; near-end far-end crosstalk; package PCB interconnect; BGA package crosstalk; papers on PEEC or reduced order modeling for package and interconnect analysis; papers on near end and far end crosstalk analysis using capacitance and inductance extraction; papers on equivalent circuit or matrix based modeling of local package interconnect parasitics; papers on crosstalk modeling for BGA or package to PCB interconnect structures in high speed digital systems.
